name: Byeorege Sowoneul
source:
Everyone has a wish in their heart that they want to fulfill. That's why when shooting stars fall in the night sky, some of us make a wish, either earnestly or vaguely. Here, this boy made a wish while watching the stars fall that night. He made a desperate, yet somewhat strange wish.... and, miraculously, it was granted.
...except that the wish turned his life upside down!

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936230/?l=korean]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每个人心中，都有一个希望实现的愿望。因此，当流星划过夜空时，有人会真诚地许愿，有人则只是漫不经心地寄托心愿。而故事中的少年，也在那一夜望着坠落的星辰，许下了一个无比迫切、却又有些奇怪的愿望……奇迹般地，愿望实现了。
……只是，它也将他的生活彻底颠覆了！

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936230/?l=korean]Steam[/url]]
